_comment: RaylibGame dedicated server (#326). NOT deployed: importing it on deweyserver's panel needs the user's OK. The game is a Windows build, so the egg runs it under Wine with a virtual X display (xvfb) for the hidden GL 4.3 context the world loaders still need (Mesa llvmpipe in software). Untested under Wine: see tools/pterodactyl/README.md.
name: RaylibGame
author: noreply@anthropic.com
description: RaylibGame dedicated server: --server server.cfg (port, max players, password, save, autosave, MOTD, log). Console: help, status, list, save, say, kick, stop.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# RaylibGame install (#326): the game files come from DOWNLOAD_URL (a zip of game.exe + resources/), or are
# uploaded through the panel's file manager afterwards. Writes server.cfg with the panel's values.
set -e
cd /mnt/server
apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl unzip > /dev/null
if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]; then
  curl -fsSL "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" -o game.zip && unzip -oq game.zip && rm -f game.zip
fi
mkdir -p server
if [ ! -f server.cfg ]; then
cat > server.cfg <<EOF
# RaylibGame dedicated server (#326). key = value; '#' starts a comment. Restart the server to apply changes.
save = server/world.sav
port = ${SERVER_PORT}
max_players = ${MAX_PLAYERS}
password = ${SERVER_PASSWORD}
autosave_minutes = ${AUTOSAVE_MINUTES}
motd = ${MOTD}
seed = ${WORLD_SEED}
log = server/server.log
EOF
fi
[ -f game.exe ] || echo "game.exe is not here yet: upload the build (game.exe + resources/) through the file manager"
echo "install done"

variables.name: Autosave minutes
variables.description: Minutes between autosaves (0 = only on stop).

variables.name: World seed
variables.description: Seed for a new world (0 = random). An existing save keeps its own.

variables.name: Download URL
variables.description: Optional: a zip of the build (game.exe + resources/) fetched at install.
